method.zh: 本人訪談與原始技術報導作為影片觀察的補充。文字摘要不是新增觀看片段；遊戲參數為可玩性調校。
method.en: Player interviews and original technical reports supplement video observation. Article summaries are not additional viewed segments; game parameters are gameplay calibration.

title.zh: 林昀儒早期打法與本人訪談

finding.zh: 2019 年已具備積極擰拉、放鬆反帶與變化發球。本人把當年的成長歸因於心理與賽後自我分析。
finding.en: By 2019, Lin already combined aggressive flicks, relaxed counters and varied serves. He credited mental development and post-match self-analysis for that year’s progress.

implication.zh: 不能把早期角色簡化成只會反手，也不能從表情判定技術進步。
implication.en: An early-era model should retain multiple weapons. Facial expression does not establish technical progress.

title.zh: 林昀儒兩段式發球引拍

finding.zh: 較高拋球配合兩次引拍，短長球的準備外形接近；全身平衡與放鬆手臂是重點。
finding.en: A higher toss accommodates two preparation movements. Short and long serves have similar preparation, with whole-body balance and a relaxed arm.

implication.zh: 發球需要獨立動畫與長短球變化，不能直接沿用對拉的正手動作。
implication.en: Service needs its own animation and length choices, separate from rally forehands.

title.zh: 林昀儒發球後的第三板

finding.zh: 低的搓長球以旋轉起板，高球才強攻；長發球後留出接下一板的空間。
finding.en: He lifts low pushes with spin and attacks high returns more strongly. After a long serve, he creates room for the next fast ball.

implication.zh: AI 必須讀球高與旋轉；強攻不應只是固定力道。
implication.en: AI must read height and spin rather than apply one attack power.

finding.zh: 先移到球在身體正面，左腳前踏、上體前傾。快前臂為主，最後少量手腕控制；橫向收拍並立即還原。
finding.en: Move until the ball is in front of the body, step in with the left foot and lean forward. A fast forearm leads, with a small final wrist adjustment, lateral follow-through and immediate recovery.

implication.zh: 台內擰拉與長球反手要分成不同動作；腳步決定能否做出這個擊球。
implication.en: Table flicks and long-ball backhands require different clips; footwork governs reach.

title.zh: 從擰拉依賴到接發球組合
title.en: From flick reliance to receive combinations

finding.zh: 本人說法蘭克福改用更多擺短、速推；對手等擰拉或正手前球太外側時改變接法。文中同對手兩場擰拉後得分為 5/16 與 12/25，僅代表這兩場。
finding.en: He added stops and fast pushes at Frankfurt, changing receive when the opponent waited for his flick or the serve went too wide. Reported point outcomes after flicks were 5/16 and 12/25 in two Ma Long matches; these are match-specific.

implication.zh: 遊戲依來球與對手站位改用推球；數字不直接當成角色命中率。
implication.en: The game changes to pushes based on ball and opponent position; these counts are not character accuracy rates.

finding.zh: 2017 年對奧恰洛夫的現場報導已記錄早點反手主導回合，也記錄正手對拉與決勝局失誤。
finding.en: The 2017 Ovtcharov match report documents early backhand contacts controlling rallies, alongside forehand exchanges and deciding-game errors.

implication.zh: 早期特徵是時間壓力；不能把一場失誤解釋成不會正手。
implication.en: The early defining feature is time pressure. Errors in one match do not mean he lacked a forehand.

title.zh: 張本對穩定性與正反手銜接的自評
title.en: Harimoto on consistency and linking strokes

finding.zh: 本人說不必勉強進攻時就不打，但有時會擋太多；反手已有信心，仍要加強正手和反手之間的連動。
finding.en: He described reducing forced attacks, sometimes blocking too much, and needing stronger forehand–backhand links despite confidence in his backhand.

implication.zh: 被壓制時可短擋還原，有空間時才接正手；不是每一板都最大力。
implication.en: Use compact blocks under pressure, then forehands when space permits rather than maximal power on every stroke.

title.zh: 張本本人談近年的正手強化

finding.zh: 官方產品頁的本人引言說，近年強化正手對拉後，不必再過度依賴反手。產品行銷引言不能單獨證明改善幅度。
finding.en: His statement on the official product page describes improved forehand exchanges and less dependence on backhand. A marketing testimonial alone cannot quantify the improvement.

implication.zh: 近期 AI 保留近台反手特色，同時在正手側來球使用完整轉體進攻。
implication.en: The current AI retains close-table backhands while using a full-body forehand against suitable wide balls.
